record.limits_note: A card entered for the paid tier is only verified: 'No — when you enter a card we only verify the card. Your card is only charged at the end of the billing cycle.' No hold amount is stated.
record.reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the free tier is described as always-on, which is why the unresolved card question matters
record.notes: Arithmetic: 730 h x (0.5 x USD 0.01667 + 1 x USD 0.00833) = USD 12.17 a month for an always-on 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB service, leaving USD 7.83 = 130 GB of egress at USD 0.06/GB if egress draws on the same allowance, which is inferred and not stated. Unverified: the pricing page says none is needed, the docs say one is. The 'No card needed' badge on the pricing page is contradicted by the billing docs and by the page's own FAQ, which presupposes a card. The USD 20 a month of resources is real and sits behind the card. A 2026-10-24 re-read also found the plan is 'Always on, no sleeping', which is the only free-tier-shaped offer in this market that does not sleep, and 730 h x (0.5 x 0.01667 + 1 x 0.00833) = USD 12.17 of the allowance.

free_tier.stated: Sandbox plan at USD 0: 'Up to $20/mo of resources on Northflank Cloud', '2 services, 2 jobs, and 1 database', 'Always on, no sleeping', plus '1 BYOC cluster, up to 12 vCPU and 48 GB'.

retention.stated: resources persist while the plan holds; the free allowance resets monthly and nothing states a deletion on exhaustion

egress.terms: Network egress USD 0.06 per GB, ingress free. The free plan publishes no separate egress allowance, so the inference recorded here is that egress is drawn from the same USD 20 resource allowance; the pricing page does not say so in as many words.

identity_cost.detail: A payment method is required for every plan: the billing documentation states 'all users must add a payment method to start creating resources on Northflank, regardless of plan selection'. The Sandbox plan card carries a 'No card needed' badge and the pricing FAQ answers 'when you enter a card we only verify the card', so the same page both advertises and presupposes a card. No hold amount is stated.

card.summary: Up to $20 a month of free resources on Northflank Cloud, across 2 services, 2 jobs, and 1 database.

free_tier.stated: Up to $20 a month of free resources on Northflank Cloud, across 2 services, 2 jobs, and 1 database.

egress.terms: Free Sandbox is a $20/month resource credit; network egress is $0.06/GB for everyone, so the credit buys at most 333 GB of egress if nothing else is spent.; ingress: tcp+udp

record.interface_detail: "Load balancers can be included in Northflank templates for infrastructure as code" plus a REST API.
record.tooling: Dashboard, API, and template YAML (kind: LoadBalancer); point an A record at the provisioned IP.
record.chaining: A Northflank UDP load balancer in front of a wg-quick sidecar gives a stable endpoint; the $20 credit and $0.06/GB egress cap the volume, not the protocol.
record.binding_note: $20 of credit at $0.06/GB is 333 GB, 0.30 TiB, and only if no compute is spent. 1 TiB of egress alone would cost $61.44/month.
record.reliability_note: "Updating a load balancer triggers re-provisioning. There may be a brief traffic interruption during the update." Backends must be running, not paused.
record.confidence_note: Whether the free Sandbox may create an L4 load balancer is not stated on any page read.

evidence.proved: L4 load balancers route "external TCP or UDP traffic", stable public IP, up to 100 ports, no rate limiting
Free Sandbox: $20/month of resources, 2 services, no card; network egress $0.06/GB
"Only HTTP and HTTP/2 ports can be publicly exposed. TCP and UDP service ports require a separate Layer 4 load balancer"

record.notes: Cloud application platform supporting background services and networking. Egress gateways are billed at USD 15 monthly; load balancer pricing and free-tier allocation terms are unstated in the plan matrix.

extras.wg_detail: A team-level Layer 4 load balancer with Protocol: TCP or UDP, a stable public IP once Provisioned, up to 100 ports, no TLS termination and no rate limiting.
extras.volume_stated: Free Sandbox is a $20/month resource credit; network egress is $0.06/GB for everyone, so the credit buys at most 333 GB of egress if nothing else is spent.
extras.transit_note: Northflank's cloud provisions the L4 balancer; the datagrams land on the service.
